items.text: feel like i'm just getting started in a very large universe, love the aesthetic and the navigation computer parts.   some mechanics don't feel well explained or intuitive, but the game is just forgiving enough to give some time for trial and error to figure things out. feel like the navigation computer is still a little buggy, frequently not letting me pan around the area and locking me out of zoom functions for no apparent reason or drifting uncontrollably, otherwise i'm looking forward to getting deeper into this game
items.text_zh: 感觉我就像在一个非常庞大的宇宙里刚刚起步，我喜欢它的美术风格和导航计算机部分。有些机制感觉解释得不够清楚，也不够直观，但游戏足够宽容，给了你一些时间通过试错来弄明白。感觉导航计算机还是有点小毛病，经常无缘无故不让我平移查看周围区域，还把我锁在缩放功能之外，或者不受控制地漂移，除此之外，我很期待更深入地玩这款游戏

observations.description: 导航电脑会不受控制地漂移
